messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick preflight for the AcmeCloud co-webinar next Tue 11am PT — want to lock speaker order, demo handoffs, and swag cutoffs.
aj-sales: I have final confirmation from Acme: they want a 10m keynote, 20m joint demo, 15m live Q&A. Can we fit a 10-seat hands-on lab after?
cameron-devex: Hands-on lab OK but need to confirm infra for signups. We can use the shared sandbox but it needs credentials rotated. @lina-partnereng can you provide an ex-auth token by EOD?
lina-partnereng: Yep. Will generate a read-only token and a short runbook. ETA 5pm today. Also we should standardize the demo dataset to avoid PII surprises.
sophie-ops: AV checklist — venue has HDMI + SDI. We should plan a laptop + backup laptop + USB-C dongle. Also schedule an AV check 60m prior. I can book it.
maria-partnerships: Perfect. Speaker order proposal: 1) Acme keynote (10m) 2) Redwood short intro (5m) 3) joint deep-dive demo (20m) 4) live Q&A (15m) 5) lab signup reminder + wrap (5m). Thoughts?
aj-sales: Fine. For the joint demo, we need a graceful fallback if cloud region is slow — can we pre-record a short 2min clip as backup?
cameron-devex: Good idea. I'll record a 2min clip and keep it on loop on our laptop. Also will capture a short screen recording of the API call: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <DEMO_TOKEN>" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
lina-partnereng: Token will be scoped to the sandbox. I'll add a README with the exact endpoints and the sample prompt sets.
sophie-ops: Swag timeline: need to finalize items by Friday for standard US shipping. If we want any partner co-branded stickers + a tiny hardware trinket we need vendor lead time 7 business days.
maria-partnerships: Can marketing confirm swag qty? @aj-sales how many expected registrants vs onsite seats?
aj-sales: We expect ~400 registrants, ~120 onsite. Suggest 150 swag kits (onsite + some speaker extras + partner reps).
maria-partnerships: Sounds good. I'll ping marketing. Also logistics: shipping addresses for gear to the venue — will post address in the channel once Sophie confirms pickup window.
sophie-ops: Address: "The Loft, 480 Harbor Dr, Suite B". Pickup window Thurs 9am-4pm. Labels to use: "Redwood x Acme — Conference Demo". Use this in your vendor form.
cameron-devex: One more thing — we should rehearse handoff between speakers 2x. Who will trigger the demo start? Recommend speaker A initiates, speaker B does the deep-dive.
lina-partnereng: Acme's engineer (Priya) will do the deep-dive. We'll do a dry run tomorrow 10am PT. Can everyone confirm availability?
maria-partnerships: I can do 10am. @aj-sales @cameron-devex @lina-partnereng @sophie-ops please react when you can make it. :calendar:
event-bot: Reminder created: "Acme x Redwood — Dry Run" Thu 10:00 PT — invites sent to participants.
aj-sales: Confirmed.
cameron-devex: Confirmed. I'll bring the backup recording and the laptop.
lina-partnereng: Confirmed.
sophie-ops: Confirmed. I'll bring dongles and label printer.
maria-partnerships: Final checklist for tomorrow's dry run:
- confirm tokens + README (Lina)
- record 2min backup clip (Cameron)
- AV check plan + dongles (Sophie)
- swag qty + vendor confirmation (Maria -> marketing)
- draft slide deck + speaker bios (Aj)
Please post one-line updates in this thread after you finish each item.
aj-sales: Posted slide deck draft in GDrive: https://drive.google.com/example (owner: aj-sales). Added speaker bios.
cameron-devex: 2min clip uploaded to drive: https://drive.google.com/clip (label: backup-demo.mp4)
lina-partnereng: Token + README uploaded to sandbox repo. Token name: redwood-acme-demo.
sophie-ops: Vendor confirmed sticker + trinket. Shipping ETA Fri morning. I'll update once pickup is arranged.
maria-partnerships: Awesome. If nothing else we can close this out after the dry run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
aj-sales: One last ask — can we set expectation with Acme to provide a 1-slide partner blurb for the intro? Short bullets only.
lina-partnereng: I'll request that now.
maria-partnerships: Cool. Closing the loop here — will archive post-demo notes in a short playbook and attach to the event page.
